en-US.title: Cross Stitch: Color by Number
en-US.short_description: Color by number with beautiful cross-stitch thread embroidery! Relax offline.
en-US.full_description:
Welcome to Cross Stitch: Color by Number — the most relaxing handmade craft and embroidery game! Step into a cozy world of thread, needles, and canvas. Bring vintage floral wreaths, sweet home samplers, colorful folk birds, woodland animals, and intricate Celtic designs to life stitch by stitch. Tap the numbers, select your colorful embroidery threads, and watch your fabric tapestry blossom with realistic X-stitches. 100% offline — stitch anytime, anywhere without internet!

Whether you are an avid needlecrafter, love cross-stitch samplers, or simply want a soothing, stress-free activity to unwind after a busy day, Cross Stitch: Color by Number brings the timeless joy of embroidery right to your fingertips.

---

🧵 A COZY GALLERY OF EMBROIDERY PATTERNS

• Vintage Flowers & Wreaths: Romantic roses, delicate lavender bouquets, sunflowers, and botanical ferns.
• Folk & Woodland Creatures: Charming songbirds, gentle foxes, cozy owls, monarch butterflies, and honeybees.
• Classic Samplers & Home Decor: "Home Sweet Home" heart samplers, cottage gardens, and tea time cups.
• Celtic & Traditional Motifs: Ornate cross-stitch borders, Celtic crosses, and folk art medallions.
• Handcrafted Aesthetic: Realistic woven linen canvas texture and tactile thread rendering for an authentic needlework feel.

✨ WHY YOU'LL LOVE CROSS STITCH: COLOR BY NUMBER

• 100% Offline Play: Stitch relaxing patterns on a plane, train, or cozy sofa — no Wi-Fi or mobile data needed!
• Satisfying ASMR Stitching: Feel the gentle, tactile rhythm of placing each thread stitch into the woven fabric.
• Smooth & Intuitive Controls: Effortlessly zoom in, pan across large canvases, and color by number with one tap.
• Time-Lapse Replay: Watch your finished embroidery come together from the very first stitch to the final masterpiece, and share it with family and friends.
• Pure Creative Relaxation: No timers, no pressure, and no penalties. Just mindful, calming creative meditation.
• Regular Pattern Updates: Discover new seasonal patterns, floral samplers, and charming designs added regularly.

Pick up your needle, choose your favorite thread color, and start stitching your own handmade gallery. Download Cross Stitch: Color by Number today and thread your way into peace and creativity!
